connector.name: Singapore Business Directory by sgpdirectory.com (com-sgpdirectory-singapore-business-directory)
connector.registryDescription: Singapore business directory. Search companies, UENs, and SSIC industry classifications.
connector.summary: Hosted at sgpdirectory.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.sgpdirectory, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
